calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE calendar_date IN (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date)

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_period
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT COUNT(*) as sales_count, SUM(net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND f.channel_code = 'WB'

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT channel_code, COUNT(*) as sales_count, SUM(net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
GROUP BY channel_code

SELECT DISTINCT channel_code
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY channel_code

SELECT f.channel_id, c.channel_name, COUNT(*) as sales_count, SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
GROUP BY f.channel_id, c.channel_name
ORDER BY f.channel_id

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, 
       'channel_code' as source,
       COUNT(*) as line_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
       SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
UNION ALL
SELECT d.fiscal_period, 
       'channel_id' as source,
       COUNT(*) as line_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
       SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, source

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3))
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
